purpose: 响应用户中景稀少/偏小和前方氛围不可见的反馈，扩大成组地标与真正前景
player_experience: 正常游戏比例能看见风车钟塔台地的中景细节，以及人物前方边缘枝草框景
constraints: No physics, gameplay RNG, route, resource or save edits
Preserve full foreground bounds+wind functional/UI keepout
Rapid iteration: no full CI per user
deliverables: Real Godot motion clip and public observational review page

creative_decisions.decision: 扩大成组风车、钟塔、石桥与台地的中景，保留材质；以可见前方枝草框景替代几乎透明的假存在
